faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Konkan Railway Corporation (KRCL) for filling up project-based positions across India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name advertised in this notification is Assistant Electrical Engineer under the PSU field.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in KRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Electrical Engineer post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree/Diploma in Electrical/Electronics/Mechanical Engineering along with relevant experience in the specified domain.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assistant Electrical Engineer?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is up to 63 years as per the guidelines outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive compensation under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-10, including corresponding grade pay details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 28 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through Email mode to the designated official address provided by Konkan Railway Corporation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening followed by vigilance and D&AR clearance of the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at www.konkanrailway.com and download the notification PDF for complete details.
